<!-- Breadcrumb: Box nav > ol > li, Link (href, not disabled) or Text span; aria-current="page" on the current item. -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from "vue";
import Box from "../kit/ui/box/Box.vue";
import Link from "../kit/ui/link/Link.vue";
import Text from "../kit/ui/text/Text.vue";
import { cn } from "../kit/utils";

type Item = { label?: string; href?: string; current?: boolean; disabled?: boolean };
defineOptions({ name: "Breadcrumb", inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps<{ items?: Item[]; ariaLabel?: string }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const rest = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...r } = attrs;
  return r;
});
const cls = computed(() => cn("text-sm", attrs.class as string | undefined));
const st = (it: Item) => cn("text-sm", (it.current ? 'font-medium' : it.disabled ? 'text-muted-foreground' : 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline'));
</script>

<template>
  <Box tag="nav" :class="cls" :aria-label="props.ariaLabel || 'Breadcrumb'" v-bind="rest"><Box tag="ol" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><Box v-for="(it, i) in props.items ?? []" :key="i" tag="li" class="inline-flex items-center"><Link v-if="it.href && !it.disabled" :href="it.href" :class="st(it)" :aria-current="it.current ? 'page' : undefined">{{ it.label }}</Link><Text v-else tag="span" :class="st(it)" :aria-current="it.current ? 'page' : undefined">{{ it.label }}</Text></Box></Box></Box>
</template>
